description: Audora can design a logo, cover art, brand colors and typefaces, artist photos, and promotion posts and short videos for the artist. Those are made inside Audora, not through this connection: call this to get the exact page to send the artist to, with a sentence on what they will find there. Use it whenever the artist wants a logo, artwork, a cover, visuals, photos or promo video made.

album_id.description: For cover_art on an album or EP.

artist.description: Only when you are connected as a label: the roster artist this call is for — their artist_user_id from list_roster, or their exact artist name. Required for every artist tool on a label connection. Leave it out on an artist's own connection.

name: design_in_audora
title: Open Audora's design tools
